abstraction_design.rationale: The abstractions track the app's real variation well (cardsFor's extra callback, config-driven table sorting, uniform Section), so the Items scenario is mostly new files; the one flaw is that homeList and teamDetails copy the type-to-card mapping instead of reusing the existing helpers.

findings.issue: Card/sprite construction is duplicated three times (card():114, homeList:185, teamDetails:341), so a sprite or card-field change needs three edits
findings.suggestion: Extract a spriteUrl(id) helper and route homeList and teamDetails card building through card() (or a shared cardFromSpecies helper)

findings.issue: teamDetails duplicates the typesById slot-mapping already written in homeList (152-160)
findings.suggestion: Extract a typesByPokemonId() helper (or a cached cardsWithTypes()) and use it from both call sites

findings.issue: Single global stylesheet means feature removal (e.g., Abilities) silently leaves dead rules (.plain-list, card__note)
findings.suggestion: Group selectors by feature with a comment header, or move to Solid's scoped css when pruning becomes a chore

findings.issue: Deleting a route leaves the query and data-function exports orphaned with no compiler signal
findings.suggestion: Run a quick unused-export check (knip/ts-prune) when removing a feature, or co-locate the query next to its route file

findings.issue: The Pokémon page is the largest file (~190 lines) with Stats/Evolution/Moves/Pokemon all inline
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is; if the page grows further, split the sub-components into app/src/components or a pokemon/ directory

findings.issue: showLevel boolean prop is flag-creep if more per-method column variants appear
findings.suggestion: If variants grow, switch to a columns prop computed alongside the table data

summary: A cleanly layered SolidStart v2 app where server data access, the server-function seam, routes, and presentational components are sharply separated, so every change scenario is cheap and localized. The only real editability debt is duplicated card/type-mapping construction inside pokeapi.ts (three sprite sites, two typesById copies), which a small helper extraction would eliminate. Removal and extension follow one uniform, greppable per-resource pattern with no entangled state.
